items.title: Otoplo Wallet v5.3.0

items.summary: Otoplo Wallet 5.3.0 adds an option to refresh vault balances when the amounts shown are missing or wrong.

items.title: Wally 3.31.00
items.author: Andrea Suisani
items.summary: Wally Wallet 3.31.00 publishes its docs to GitLab Pages and adds support for converting balances into more fiat currencies.

items.title: libnexakotlin 0.7.0
items.author: Andrew Stone
items.summary: libnexakotlin 0.7.0 moves to the AGP 9 Kotlin Multiplatform library structure and rebuilds a wallet database that can't be opened.

items.title: Nexa 2.2.0.0
items.author: Andrea Suisani
items.summary: The GitLab release page for Nexa full node 2.2.0.0 has signed binaries for Linux, ARM, macOS and Windows.

items.summary: Otoplo Wallet 5.2.1 speeds up wallet key discovery for faster syncing.

items.title: Rostrum 14.0.1
items.author: Dagur Valberg Johannsson
items.summary: Rostrum 14.0.1 fixes a broken lock file and updates dependencies.

items.title: Rostrum 14.0.0
items.author: Dagur Valberg Johannsson
items.summary: Rostrum 14.0.0, the Electrum server for Nexa, adds new RPCs and opt-in protocol editions. It also needs a full reindex because of a new database layout.

items.title: Otoplo Wallet v5.2.0
items.author: vgrunner
items.summary: Otoplo Wallet 5.2.0 adds a notification centre for wallet updates and dapp requests, along with faster wallet scanning.

items.title: Otoplo Wallet v5.1.0

items.title: Otoplo Wallet v5.0.0
